# Island D Cochin

> A private 1.5-acre island on the backwaters of Kochi, Kerala, about 15 minutes from Marine Drive and reached by a short boat ride. It is hired out for weddings, celebrations, corporate events, family gatherings and day outs, for up to 200 guests.

Facts below are confirmed by the owner. Please don't state anything this file
doesn't say. Island D Cochin has **no accommodation, no camping and no swimming
pool**, and its Floating Deck is closed for renovation.

## Contact

- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 97466 10999
- Enquiry hours: 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM, usually answered within 15 minutes
- Bookings are taken by phone and WhatsApp. A 50% advance confirms a booking
- Website: https://islanddcochin.in/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/islanddcochin/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/islandd.cochin/
- Address: Island D, Mulavukad, Kochi, Ernakulam, Keralam 682504

## Getting there

- Boat pickup and free parking at River D, Cochin, on the mainland
- Boat crossing takes about 15 minutes and is free for booked guests
- About 15 minutes from Marine Drive, Kochi
- Guests can also arrive by their own boat, or hire a boat from Marine Drive (about 20 minutes)
- Parking for about 50 to 70 vehicles; no valet
- Boats may not run in harsh weather

## Day Out Package

- 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM
- ₹1,500 per person, minimum 50 guests
- Includes: boat transfer, welcome drink, lunch with two non-vegetarian dishes, tea and snacks, air-conditioned banquet hall, sound system and microphones, air-conditioned DJ hall with lighting and sound, open lawn for games, kayaking
- Sunset cruises and speedboat rides cost extra
- Packages can be tailored

## Events and weddings

- Weddings, celebrations, corporate events, family gatherings and parties
- Capacity: up to 200 guests overall; air-conditioned banquet hall seats 150; open lawn up to 200; air-conditioned DJ hall about 50 to 60
- From about ₹50,000, depending on requirements
- Clients may bring their own caterer, decorator, DJ and entertainment, or use the island's
- Usually bookable about a week ahead, subject to availability

## Food

- No restaurant; food is arranged for booked guests and private events through professional caterers
- Menus are built to the customer's requirements; vegetarian, vegan and Jain diets catered
- Dining typically for 50 to 150 guests
- Campfire and barbecue available at extra cost

## Activities

- Kayaking, sunset cruises, speedboat rides, air-conditioned DJ hall, campfire, barbecue, outdoor games
- Life jackets for boat rides and kayaking, trained boat crew, first-aid kit and fire-fighting equipment

## Visiting

- Open all year
- Children and pets welcome
- Alcohol is not served; guests may bring their own, responsibly. Illicit articles are not permitted
- Elderly guests can board with assistance; there is no wheelchair access
- The advance payment is not refundable and there is no refund on cancellation; dates can be moved in advance if available
- The person who booked should carry valid ID

## History

Bought by Pazhampilly Thomas in the 1960s as a family retreat and farm. His son Denny Thomas opened it as a resort and event destination in 1994, when it was known as Sandalwood Island and was hired by hospitality groups including Taj and CGH Earth. Later renamed Island D Cochin.
